annotations.title: Hunt for crashes with random play

description: Random taps, drags, keys and backgrounding, repeatable by seed. Reports uncaught errors, failed requests, hangs, soft-locks and a render loop that stops, each with a command that reproduces it.

area.description: CSS selector of the game area (default: the largest canvas)

ready.description: JavaScript expression that is true once the game has loaded

scenario.description: Name of a scenario in playproof.config.json: supplies steps, duration, zoom and device

seed.description: Random seed (default 1); the same seed replays the same actions

target.description: URL (e.g. http://localhost:5173), folder (./dist) or HTML file of the game. Optional when playproof.config.json sets it.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before starting

name: monkey
title: Hunt for crashes with random play
